workstreams.name: Core liability framework (§§ 1295, 1298, 1299 ABGB)
workstreams.goal: Establish fault-based liability elements: Rechtsgutverletzung, Kausalität, Verschulden, Rechtswidrigkeit

workstreams.name: Informed consent & causation defense (§ 1313a, § 1325 ABGB)
workstreams.goal: Assess impact of signed Risikoaufklärung and absence of specific Lagerungsrisiko disclosure on causation and liability exclusion

workstreams.name: Damages & future loss (Schmerzengeld, Verdienstentgang, Zukunftsschäden)
workstreams.goal: Identify OGH jurisprudence on quantification, proof, and admissibility of future damage claims in medical malpractice

synthesis_focus: Establish whether lack of specific Lagerungsrisiko disclosure breaks the chain of informed consent, thereby preserving full liability despite signed general Risikoaufklärung — with emphasis on OGH RS and commentary on § 1313a ABGB.
